title: Chosen compactification and compact-support image
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ admit a chosen compactification

$$
X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y,
\qquad f=pj,
$$

with $j$ a quasi-compact open immersion and $p$ proper. For this datum set

$$
Rf_!^{(j,p)}E:=Rp_*j_!E.
$$

For proper $f$, its identity compactification is $(j,p)=(1_X,f)$.

lean.statement: def proEtaleRingCompactSupportImage {Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (d : Compactification f) [QuasiCompact d.i] (RY : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (RZ : Sheaf (ProEt.topology d.Z) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (RX : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (cp : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage d.g CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RY ≅ RZ) (cj : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage d.i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RZ ≅ RX) : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X RX) ⥤ DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules Y RY)
lean.note: The recorded Etale functor acts on etale sheaves in a fixed abelian category, not the ringed pro-etale modules needed here. This module supplies canonical open extension via the adjoint universal property, its exact derived descent, and Rp_*j_! for the chosen quasi-compact open/proper compactification; the identity compactification is upstream Compactification.ofIsProper.
